name: Hagiwara Miku
source: She is pure and innocent in her thinking and trusts people immediately if they are even slightly kind to her. She does not like to be treated like a child, but when she is told something difficult or theoretical, she says, "I don't understand!" She is also quick to sulk. She is very attached to her brother-in-law, Junichi, and spoils him when he is in sight.
